facts.P1_fx_receipts: Restricted by sanctions; most Western platforms don't serve Russia.

facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Progressive 13–22% on income since 2025; many freelancers use NPD instead.

facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
facts.L7_incentives: Self-employed NPD: 4% from individuals, 6% from companies, up to 2.4 million roubles.
